title: Phone battery triage during a long outage
summary: A phone-preservation routine for outages lasting more than a few hours, when calls, maps, medicine reminders, and emergency alerts compete for the same battery.
content: Core sequence: 1) Set one household phone as the alert phone and keep it on but unused for entertainment. 2) Write essential numbers on paper before battery drops below half. 3) Use airplane mode between scheduled check-ins if official alerts are still being received another way. 4) Charge one device at a time from a power bank and record the remaining percentage after each use. Stop point: Do not use this card for phone battery triage during a long outage to replace emergency services, medical prescriptions, utility professionals, or official evacuation orders. Main warnings: Do not treat phone battery triage during a long outage as finished until the result is visible, dated, and understood by the next person. Do not continue phone battery triage during a long outage when smell, heat, illness, violence, rising water, or official instructions indicate immediate danger.
